caption: The drawing depicts a bedroom scene with two people lying in a bed. The bed is large, featuring an ornate wooden frame with decorative gold-like details. The person on the left, who has curly reddish-brown hair, is lying on their side and appears to be resting or sleeping, covered up to the shoulders by a light beige blanket with a delicate pattern. The person on the right, who has short brown hair and a beard, is propped up on their elbows, reading a book. On the right side of the bed is a small nightstand, upon which sits a brown candlestick with a lit candle. Behind the bed, there is a tall grandfather clock and a chair with a red seat and ornate back. The window in the background is covered by heavy, dark red curtains with a white section in the center, tied back with a decorative cord. The wall behind the bed is plain with a muted grayish-brown color. The scene is surrounded by a border made up of geometric quilt-like patterns in shades of brown, red, pink, white, and green. Four small squares with number-like symbols are also integrated into the border, placed near the corners. The composition uses a limited color palette primarily featuring earthy tones, reds, and muted pinks.
title: Printed Cotton
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
